Sandbox_AnomalousStormDaysMin_tooltip: Minimum days between emissions, inclusive. The original minimum is 3 days.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormDaysMax_tooltip: Maximum days between emissions, inclusive. The original code produces 3-6 days by default.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormLength_tooltip: Duration of the strong storm phase in hours. Default 1 hour matches the original mod.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormWarningMinutes_too: A red-sky phase without rain before the storm. Default 0, matching the original; higher values add a custom warning.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormThunderDelayMinute: Time from the start of STAGE_STORM until thunder and exposure damage begin. Default 60 matches the original mod.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormCalmRainMinutes: Anomalous Storm: Calm Rain after Thunder (Minutes)
Sandbox_AnomalousStormCalmRainMinutes_to: How long exposed zombies remain slowed after the dangerous thunder phase ends. Default 60 matches the original overall timing.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormRedFadeMinutes_too: How long the fullscreen red mask remains after calm rain. Default 60 minutes; the effect continues until the cycle ends.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormZombieDamagePerTen: Anomalous Storm: Exposure damage per 10 minutes
Health points in hundredths per 10 minutes for exposed zombies and animals. Default 10 means 0.10 health; 0 disables gradual damage. The lethal exposure point still applies.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormZombieSlowPercent_: Exposed zombie movement speed after the thunderstorm begins; slowdown lasts until rain ends. Default 10%, very slow but still moving.
Sandbox_AnomalousStormLethalExposurePerc: Exposed zombies, animals and zombie animals die when the electrical rain reaches this percentage of its duration. Default 75%.
